designationHistory.indexText: Amagansett National Wildlife Refuge was created in 1968 on the site of the former Amagansett Lifesaving Station on Long Island's south fork.
designationHistory.note: One FWS web source; it says the land was acquired in 1968 and 'declared a National Wildlife Refuge by President Lyndon Johnson'. No order or other record of a presidential action was found, so the authority is left unconfirmed. Wikipedia also gives 1968 (lead only).

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Amagansett NWR 'About Us' page
